comment: The hand-made anchors of the WILDS (tools/generate_wilds.ts). Positions are fractions of the region (0..1); the generator snaps each to the nearest fitting land and grows the rest around them.

city.comment: the CITY (tools/generate_city.ts, 400x400) on the west coast: its left column (x * width) and top row (y * height). Its harbor opens on the sea; its avenues run out through gates in its belt of trees to the island's roads

cave.name: CAVE MOUTH
cave.comment: the CAVERN (tools/generate_cavern.ts, 400x400) lies inside a mountain of the island: its entrance column is x * width, its top row y * height. The mountain is solid rock around it, and the cave mouth opens on its north face
